purpose: Use existing finished matches while the fixed future cohort is pending; never rewrite its forecasts
preliminaryGate: Both probability metrics must improve over v1 in validation and retrospective audit; report all outcomes even if the gate fails
limitations: Historical final scores are observed now; this is retrospective development, not an untouched prospective test.
Some EPL periods have already been studied in earlier experiments.
First-season predictions lack older-season data; missing early histories are excluded by the production model's own minimums.
New calibration is not an injury model. It cannot create missing historical availability information.
Original one-hundred-match forecasts and inputs remain immutable.
